d: Bihar Job Scam: bihar vidhan parishad sachivalay men 100 se adhik padon par huee niyuktiyon ko lekar siyasi ghamasan tej ho gaya hai... niyukti prakriya aur karmachariyon ki karyakshamta par uthe savalon ke bad ab dakshata ki dobara janch ho rahi hai... lekin is janch ne siyasat ko aur garma diya hai... RJD emaelsi sunil sinh ne pichhle 15 se 20 sal men rahe sabhi vidhan parishad sabhaptiyon aur vidhanasbha adhyakshon ke karyakal ki janch ki mang kar di hai... vahin kangres ne bhi niyuktiyon par saval uthae hain... jabki bijepi ne purane karyakal ki bahali par bhi janch ki mang ki…
